title: Conjugated restricted morphisms depend only on the left coset
statement: Let k be a commutative ring, G a group, A and B k-linear G-representations in the same representation universe, and H ≤ G. Let F : Res_H B → Res_H A be an H-equivariant k-linear map. If s,t ∈ G have the same left coset in G/H, then for every x ∈ B, ρ_A(s)(F(ρ_B(s⁻¹)x)) = ρ_A(t)(F(ρ_B(t⁻¹)x)). No finiteness or normality assumption is required.
lean_statement: ∀ {k G : Type _} [CommRing k] [Group G] (A B : Rep k G) (H : Subgroup G) (F : Quiver.Hom (Rep.res H.subtype B) (Rep.res H.subtype A)) (s t : G), (QuotientGroup.mk s : G ⧸ H) = QuotientGroup.mk t → ∀ x : B, A.ρ s (F.hom (B.ρ s⁻¹ x)) = A.ρ t (F.hom (B.ρ t⁻¹ x))
